name: Gradient-Based Shading
definition: A discrete volume rendering method (DVR) that renders a 3D texture using front-to-back accumulation, shading voxels using a pseudo-normal estimated from the volume gradient and a directional light model.
summary: Gradient-Based Shading is a discrete volume rendering technique that shades voxels using pseudo-normals estimated from volume gradients and a simple Lambertian model, distinguishing it from methods using complex microfacet or metallic reflections.
